result.title: MoDDiT: Simple Token Routing in Diffusion Transformers
result.summary: Real-time video generation, interactive world models, and on-device image synthesis are almost a reality. Diffusion Transformers (DiT) achieve excellent sample quality, shifting the bottleneck to the throughput of the models themselves. Natural images are inherently sparse, as large portions of an image are often background, contribute little to the scene content, and are easy to denoise. DiTs fail to exploit this sparsity, as they process image tokens statically and uniformly. We propose MoDDiT, a simple architecture modification that learns to route tokens through both MLP and self-attention operations. By routing tokens through both blocks independently, MoDDiT allows for dynamic compute allocation in MLPs that varies across tokens, images, and denoising timesteps. Using MoDDiT to train image generation models from scratch significantly reduces computational costs of training and inference, processing as few as 12.5% of the tokens. By increasing sparsity and model depth, MoDDiT reduces costs and improves generation performance over unrouted baselines. The learned allocation is interpretable, revealing how computation varies with visual content and noise level. We also use MoDDiT to train video generation models, where allocation correlates with motion, and to distill a dense bidirectional video model into a sparse autoregressive student.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MoDDiT，在 DiT 中让 token 分别独立地经 MLP 与自注意力进行路由，实现随 token、图像和去噪步变化的动态计算分配，仅处理约 12.5% 的 token 即可完成图像与视频生成训练，并可将稠密双向视频模型蒸馏为稀疏自回归学生。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按 token 与时间步学习计算分配、且分配结果可解释的做法，或可类比 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与动态计算预算；从稠密双向教师到稀疏自回归学生的蒸馏，可供核查轨迹式训练与贡献分配的迁移线索。
